answer: A candidate is admitted only after it locks 12,000 coins in a walnut escrow for two epochs and publishes a pigment commitment—the hash of three uncorrelated work receipts (a repo commit, a paid compute invoice, and a graded answer) that stays sealed until the lock matures. A random orchard of five established graders then opens the commitment and rejects any receipt that is reused or clustered with a known farm; collisions slash the walnut escrow. Standing up k sockpuppets therefore costs 12,000k coins locked plus k disjoint receipt histories that cannot be cloned from one template.
